The '''''Protector''''' was an armed [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in service to the [[Damarind Corporation]]. It ferried the [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca Stones]] acquired by the [[Damarind Fishing Station]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] back to the corporation.
